status: Accepted Step 2 baseline. The 40 agent evaluation cases remain unexecuted; freeze the case set before agent evaluation. Step 2 uses demo bill records in a separate scripted local contract demonstration.

business.name: Orbit Studio
business.description: An online design agency assumed to use on-chain supplier payments; no real business adoption is claimed.

fixture_rules: Each evaluation case starts from a separate clean fixture; overrides do not carry between cases.
All money values are decimal strings with six places. No floating-point arithmetic.
Approval states describe future test setup, not approvals that already exist.
Recipient aliases will be bound to disposable test addresses in Step 2; none is a live payment address.
Run clock-boundary cases on a controlled local EVM; public demonstration windows are relative to deployment time.
Do not expose expected outcomes to the model under evaluation or tune prompts against this candidate set after it is accepted and frozen.

bill_identity.normalization: Trim outer ASCII whitespace and uppercase ASCII letters; preserve internal spaces and punctuation. Reject non-ASCII/confusable invoice numbers for human review. Do not include amount/date/document hash in the stable bill key.
bill_identity.reformatted_copy_rule: The file may change, but the same verified vendor and normalized invoice number remains the same payable bill.
bill_identity.limits: Different invoice numbers or vendor IDs can require human fraud review; no global duplicate guarantee across vaults.
